dedupe_keys.name: pipeline submarine on land polyline hydro 1 22k 1 90k series on linz data service

description: Pipeline, submarine on land polyline (Hydro, 1:22k 1:90k (series on LINZ Data Service) is a series of datasets listed in LINZ Data Service (data.linz.govt.nz), New Zealand, an open data portal, published or maintained by New Zealand Hydrographic Authority. A pipeline is a string of interconnected pipes used for the transport of matter, nowadays mainly oil or gas. A submarine or land pipeline is a pipeline lying on or buried under the seabed or the land. Coverage: New Zealand. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher New Zealand Hydrographic Authority. Its tags are New Zealand. It offers 1 resource(s) in vector. The portal shows 2023-04-13 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the portal's own catalogue entry (title, description, tags, licence, formats and dates) read through its API, so the data files were not opened, their contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support pipeline routing and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-nz-linz-portal.
